inspired_by: The Blue Jackal, from the Panchatantra
learning: Being yourself, and owning up when you have told a fib

characters.name: Neelu
characters.who: a hungry little jackal who falls into a tub of blue dye

characters.name: Raja Singh
characters.who: the lion, now a kind friend of the jungle

characters.name: Uhu
characters.who: a wise owl who notices everything

characters.name: Hasi
characters.who: a small bunny with long ears

pages.text: The Panchatantra book glowed once more. Whoosh! Mehar landed in a dyer's yard full of big tubs of colour: red, yellow and the deepest blue. "Paint!" she gasped. "Lots and lots of paint!"
A hungry little jackal called Neelu came tiptoeing past, sniffing for food. He leaned over the blue tub, a bit too far... SPLOSH! Head first, all the way in!
Out climbed a bright blue jackal. In the jungle, everyone stared. "What strange animal is that?" Neelu puffed up his chest. "I am King Neelu! The sky sent me to rule you!"
The animals bowed. They gave him a crown and the juiciest mangoes. "Fan me!" ordered Neelu. Even Raja Singh the lion had to fan him with a big banana leaf. Mehar frowned.
Mehar whispered, "Neelu, pretending must be tiring. Why not just be yourself?" "Shh!" hissed Neelu. "Kings don't listen to little girls." But his tail drooped a tiny bit.
That night the full moon rose. Far away, the jackals began to sing: "Aa-ooo! Aa-ooo!" Neelu's nose twitched. His ears wiggled. (Can you guess what happened next?)
He couldn't help it! He threw back his head: "AAA-OOO!" Everyone froze. "A king who howls like a jackal?" hooted Uhu. "He is not from the sky at all!"
Raja Singh growled. Neelu shook. But Mehar stepped in front of him. "Wait! He told a big fib, but I think he's sorry." Neelu nodded. "I'm sorry. I'm only Neelu."
Mehar and Neelu splashed in the river until the blue washed away. Out came a fluffy brown jackal, smiling. The animals laughed and said, "Hello, Neelu! You can sing in our moon choir."
Whoosh! Mehar was back in bed with blue paint on her fingers. Before sleep, she painted a little brown jackal singing to the moon. "Aa-ooo," she yawned. Good night!

moral.en: Be yourself. A fib can hide who you are for a little while, but the truth always comes out, so it is better to tell it yourself.
moral.de: Sei du selbst. Eine Flunkerei kommt immer ans Licht.
moral.hi: जैसे हो, वैसे ही रहो। झूठ ज़्यादा देर नहीं छिपता।
moral.hi_roman: Jaise ho, vaise hi raho. Jhooth zyaada der nahin chhipta.

questions.en: Why did the animals think Neelu was a king?
What is something you love about being just you?
